poetryFrame.rightVertical: THE STARS GUIDE US BACK TO WHERE WE BELONG

sonnetLines: Across the water, deep and wide,
A gentle rhythm where dreams reside.
We search for light among the spheres,
And quiet solace through the years.
The stellar dust begins to gleam,
No distant planet holds such grace,
As found within this time and place.
A whispered promise on the air,
We chart our course by loving eyes,
Beneath these vast and painted skies.
The journey ends where hearts align,

You are all I long for

Boy, I hear you in my dreams
